sample: each task's complete 128-question DEV panel, using one frozen image group per question
e2_endpoints: actual same-run E2/000 and E2/111; no E1 substitution
e3_endpoints: OFF and MATCH reference same-question E2/000 and E2/111 from the same run

e2_primary.interpretation: each leave-one-slot effect is conditional on the other two being enabled

limits: DEV exploratory evidence; do not describe an interval crossing zero as equivalence.
All E2 arms compute the full vision tower and all three mergers; no savings are implied.
E3 misalignment interventions cannot alone establish an OCR or localized-pixel mechanism.
This file and paired.py do not access labels or predictions and do not authorize scoring.
